name: Arabians Doubt ~The Engagement on Desert~
original_name: アラビアンズ・ダウト ～The engagement on desert～
source:
Set after the normal route in Arabian’s Lost where you win the bet but don’t get a husband. Eileen finds herself forced to act as ruler after her parents take off one day on a trip. 

[From [url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2012/08/august-news-2/]Lijakaca's blog[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在《Arabians Lost》的普通路线之后：你赢得了赌局，却没有得到丈夫。一天，父母突然外出旅行，艾琳被迫代行统治者职责。

[来自[url=http://lijaka.com/blog/2012/08/august-news-2/]Lijakaca的博客[/url]]
